review_type: Inline design self-review and read-only source/metadata checks; not independent model validation

checked.data_roles: Seven-day counts confirmed from frozen roles; 86,373 inner queries, 104 unique inner validation IDs; 265,393 training pairs /338 IDs; 33,971 outer queries /45 IDs
checked.training_vs_evaluation: Pair-equal NLL fitting; drifter-equal early-stop evaluation, ES selection and outer reporting explicitly distinguished
checked.literature: Brolly sections 4.2–4.3 and author modelling.py; K meaning verified; 32 not a universal optimum; paper/code early-stop split discrepancy disclosed
checked.model_scope: Six K candidates; shared small backbone; global learning intentionally differs from unchanged local controls
checked.leakage: Whole-ID stop subset within fit role; rolling time windows for K; outer development cohort not used to select K
checked.full_data: Early-stop subset returned for full-role refit; all declared queries retained
checked.search_boundaries: Fixed seeds, K grid and one-SE selection; all outer K reports descriptive except preselected K*
checked.scoring: Same ECEF ES and LAEA 90-percent ellipse; proposed direct mixture integration has distinct nodes but unchanged precision gates
checked.resource: 32-hour proposed cap, prior authorization not inherited, no measured MDN completion-time claim
checked.inference: Engineering completion distinct from improvement; interval margins do not excuse point-estimate deterioration

limitations: Document self-review only; implementation, numerical precision and compute throughput require approved execution.
Repeatedly viewed outer development period is not an untouched final test.
Three-seed early-stop NLL comparison is not a full ES seed-stability experiment.
A single shared ellipse may span low-density gaps of a multimodal forecast.
K=32, covariance floor and small backbone are prespecified hypotheses rather than literature-proven optimal settings.
